rules.description: Business must sell, cook, store, handle, prepare or distribute food
rules.reason_if_failed: This registration is only for food businesses. If you don't handle food, you don't need to register.

rules.description: Business must have a location or operating address
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide the location where your food business operates (can be a home address, market location, or mobile vehicle base)

rules.description: Business must be located within the local authority's jurisdiction
rules.reason_if_failed: You need to register with the local authority where your food business is located

rules.description: Person registering must be the business owner or responsible person
rules.reason_if_failed: Only the business owner or someone legally responsible for the food business can register

rules.description: Business must not already be registered with this local authority
rules.reason_if_failed: This business is already registered. Contact your local authority to update your existing registration.

explanation_template: Food hygiene registration eligibility: {outcome}. Registration is free and must be completed at least 28 days before you start trading.

edge_cases.description: Mobile food business operating across multiple local authority areas
edge_cases.action: Must register with the local authority where the vehicle is kept overnight. Additional notifications may be needed for other areas.

edge_cases.description: Temporary food business (e.g., festival stall, seasonal market)
edge_cases.action: Still required to register at least 28 days before first trading day. Mark as temporary in application.

edge_cases.description: Food business operating from home address
edge_cases.action: Home-based food businesses must register. Domestic kitchen may need to meet food hygiene standards.

edge_cases.description: Business is already trading but not registered
edge_cases.action: Register immediately. Trading without registration is illegal and may result in enforcement action. Explain circumstances to local authority.

edge_cases.description: Business only sells pre-wrapped, low-risk food
edge_cases.action: Still required to register even if only selling packaged food. May result in lower inspection frequency.
